podcast.body: Released in June 2001, this was Big Wreck's second album, coming four years after their debut. The label, Atlantic Records, reportedly pressured the band to sound like Nickelback. The band, however, wanted to move in the opposite direction, leading to creative clashes and contributing to the eventual breakup of the original lineup. "The second album, the difficult second record comes out. The pleasure of the Greed in 2001."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
